proposal: IP SH directly after the HP evaporator; LP SH after the IP evaporator with a feasible LP steam temperature.
question: Rating the HRSG section by section (EPC off-design check) shows two impossible sections in PER-001 Rev A section 5: the IP superheater sits in gas at 299.9 -> 295.1 degC but delivers steam at 330 degC, and the LP superheater sits in gas at 201.5 -> 197.4 degC but delivers steam at 300 degC. Please correct the HRSG arrangement and reissue the heat balance and the HRSG datasheet.
response: Confirmed - a drafting error in the Rev 0/A section order. Corrected arrangement in PER-001 Rev B and DS-104 Rev A: IP superheater directly after the HP evaporator (gas 371.6 -> 366.9 degC, steam 330 degC), LP superheater directly after the IP evaporator (gas 261.0 -> 258.2 degC) with LP steam at 250 degC. Effect: ST output 200.73 MW (-0.16 MW), LP steam 11.90 kg/s. IP-SH duty and all pinch points unchanged.
